negative_result.claim: The historical 2026-02-25 'adaptive vision' mechanism is not evidence of a personal online visual learner.
negative_result.basis: Historical tools/frank_adaptive_vision.py contains confidence/query-triggered routing and VLM escalation; a search within the fetched file found no 'learn' or 'prototype' occurrence. No persistent user-specific prototype/classifier update loop was established by this shard.

synthesis.architecture_pattern: Project-Frankenstein repeatedly moved from layered adaptive routing toward stronger unification: staged detectors+VLM -> unified FrankEye -> native multimodal Qwen. Each simplification reduced boundary count but risked discarding useful control semantics such as explicit confidence gating, query-conditioned escalation and provenance of which subsystem contributed what.
synthesis.retina_research_implication: For Frank v0.1 do not resurrect the whole legacy stack. Preserve the high-value control semantics from the 2026-02-25 adaptive pipeline and combine them with current native multimodal perception plus a genuinely separate user-specific adaptive Micro Visual Classifier. 'Adaptive' must mean measurable learning/state update when discussing the personal learner, not merely conditional routing.
synthesis.dissolution_implication: Retina can be dissolved into the one-module runtime while retaining logical factorization in receipts/state: raw/native perception, familiarity/prototype learner, confidence/open-set gate, escalation/re-entry and final broadcast. Physical module collapse must not erase causal observability.
synthesis.anti_regression: A future optimization that removes explicit gating/provenance should be benchmarked against the historical adaptive pipeline's saved-VLM rate/latency idea and against error-localization quality, not judged only by fewer modules.

branch_feedback.frank: Preserve one current vision capability identity but make backend, learner and gating state explicit and versioned.
branch_feedback.harness: Benchmark native-only versus native+cheap familiarity gate versus historical-style staged escalation; measure latency, VLM calls, accuracy, open-set failure and causal-localization quality.
branch_feedback.claycode: Represent perception pipeline decisions as explicit transition receipts including confidence, escalation reason, learner version and backend provenance even if runtime is physically one module.
branch_feedback.claygraph: Add migration lineage edges for AdaptiveVision -> FrankEye -> NativeVision and preserve mechanism-level descendants rather than only file-level supersession.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: Persist historical/current backend identities and personal learner state separately; support rollback and replay across migration boundaries.
branch_feedback.gwt: Visual ignition/broadcast studies should distinguish native perception contribution from familiarity/gating contribution.
branch_feedback.emergenz: Ablate gating and personal learner independently to avoid mistaking routing efficiency or backend replacement for causal emergence.
branch_feedback.hyperposition: Contextual alternative paths (cheap gate vs deep native interpretation) are a concrete engineering instance of set-valued processing choices without quantum claims.
